تعترضون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَرِضُونَ (taʕtariḍūna) /taʕ.ta.ri.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# تُعْتَرَضُونَ (tuʕtaraḍūna) /tuʕ.ta.ra.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
